# IDML fixtures for shell/test/designer.e2e.mjs: a two-sided 9 x 6 in card (opens into the demo
# postcard order) and a one-page 6 x 4 in card (refused: wrong size for that order). Built with:
#
#   designcraft-cli script shell/test/fixtures/cards.txt     (from the repo root)

# 0-3: 9 x 6 in, two pages, a headline and a coloured back
file.new {"width":648,"height":432,"pages":2,"facingPages":false,"bleed":9,"margins":9,"title":"IDML card"}
frame.create {"spread":0,"rect":[72,150,576,230],"content":"text","text":"Opened from IDML"}
frame.create {"spread":1,"rect":[-9,-9,657,441],"content":"unassigned"}
object.color {"color":{"c":0,"m":60,"y":100,"k":0},"ids":["$2.id"]}
# 4-5: no outline, then the IDML
object.stroke {"swatch":"[None]","ids":["$2.id"]}
file.exportIdml {"path":"shell/test/fixtures/card-9x6.idml"}
